d:
Pul udghatan samaroh men Nitish Kumar ko nimantran nahin die jane ke mudde par siyasi bayanbaji shuru ho gaee hai. JDU neta Neeraj Kumar ne is mamle par narajgi jatate hue saval uthae. aakhir unhonne kya kaha aur kis bat ko lekar apni aapatti darj karaee? dekhie unka pura bayana.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
